Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
Ms. Mamta Arya, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. Tumul K Nainwal, learned AGA, for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
3. The instant criminal appeal has been 
preferred by the appellant – Harish S/o Trilok 
Singh (convict) against the judgment and order 
passed by the learned Special Judge (NDPS Act)
District Udham Sing Nagar, dated 25.08.2026 
passed in Sessions Trial No.460 of 2021, “State of 
Uttarakhand Vs. Harish and another”, whereby the 
appellant has been convicted for the offences 
punishable under Sections 20(b)(ii)(C) of the NDPS 
Act, and sentenced with ten years of rigorous 
imprisonment with a fine of Rs.1,25,000/-. 
4. As per the office report, the appeal is well 
within time.
5. Admit. 
6. Summon the trial court record.
7. List this appeal on 08.10.2026 along with 
CRLA No.521 of 2026.
8. In the meantime, the State Counsel may file 
their objections within two weeks’ to the bail 
application (IA No.1/2026) 
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 11.09.2026
Nitesh/

preferred by the appellant – Anil Kumar S/o 
Shri Ramesh Ram (convict) against the 
judgment and order passed by the learned
Special Judge (NDPS Act) District Udham 
Singh Nagar, dated 22/25.08.2026 in Sessions
Trial No.460 of 2021, “State of Uttarakhand
Vs. Harish and another”, whereby the 
appellant has been convicted for the offences 
punishable under Sections 20(b)(ii)(B) of the 
NDPS Act, with the sentence of ten years of 
rigorous imprisonment and fine of 
Rs.1,00,000/-. 
4. It is apprised that the appeal preferred 
by the co-accused – Harish,, is already 
admitted on 11.09.2026 and the trial court 
record is also summoned and the State was 
directed to file objections to the bail 
application, and the matter is fixed on 
08.10.2026.
5. Since this is an appeal by another co￾accused against conviction, hence it has to be  admitted.
6. Admit.
7. List this appeal on 08.10.2026 along with 
CRLA No.521 of 2026.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 23.09.2026
